title: Thank you, Scott
content: We take this opportunity to direct you to the American Institute of Biological Sciences (AIBS) board’s commendation to AIBS CEO Scott Glisson for his 30-plus years of service to and leadership of AIBS. In addition to Scott’s outstanding qualities of integrity, resilience, and leadership, we emphasize that Scott’s modus operandi of broadening collaboration and communication across AIBS, including between the staff and the board, has had a very positive impact on BioScience. We believe that BioScience has integrated Scott’s philosophy and now reflects ever increasing input from AIBS staff, AIBS board, editorial board members, authors, reviewers, Oxford University Press staff, and readership, all of which is fundamental to the ever-increasing scope and impact of the journal. We and our readers are grateful beneficiaries of his steadfast guidance and support.
